key_points: BMO CFO reports stronger loan demand and client activity despite trade uncertainty.
BMO is part of a consortium of Canada's six biggest banks exploring a Canadian‑dollar tokenized deposit system.
The digital‑dollar initiative could create new revenue streams and improve efficiency over the medium term.
Analyst actions (BMO cutting McDonald's target) are unrelated to BMO's own fundamentals.
Overall outlook remains positive with returns trending toward 2027 targets.
